# Starting the next year

Which cycle everyone is in, what an admin’s start prepares and reads back first, and when it can be undone.

## The rule

**Which cycle everyone is in** (`currentCycle`): of the cycles not removed, the latest whose week 1 has begun (its start + 7 days, on or before today); if none has, the earliest. So the next year, set up during the wrap-up, opens for everyone on its week 1's Monday and never earlier, and a year nobody follows stays current after it ends (it has ended: rule “A year’s end”). A new workspace's only cycle is current from day one, in its week 0.

**Before a cycle's week 1** (`beforeStart`) nothing is due, and the screens say when it starts: "2027 starts on Mon 4 Jan 2027, in 2 weeks. Nothing is due until then." ("next week" from 7 days before, "on Monday" in the last week before), with the first check-ins' date (week 1's review day).

**What happens to each goal** (`carryKind`), in this order: it **stops** when its owner said so at the wrap-up, unless it finished anyway; a number goal whose plan runs past the year **keeps** its plan; it **finishes** when its result is Met or Met late, its last number has reached the target, every stage is done, or its owner called it done; otherwise it **carries** on. A goal with a limit never finishes: a limit is kept every year. Goals that carry on or keep their plan go into the next year; the rest stay in this one.

**The read-back** (`startReadBack`) counts every live goal once, from `carryKind`, so what it says is what the start makes: wrapped up and carrying on (of them, keeping their plan), finishing, stopping; and not wrapped up yet (of them, carrying on as they are, and finishing). The four add up to the year's live goals.

**Starting** (`startNextCycle`): admins only; from the day the wrap-up opens (or once the year has ended); once (a second start says who started it and when). The next cycle's week 0 is this one's last week, its length follows the calendar, and its name is the year's. The change that starts it keeps the goals it added, so it can be undone.

**Undo** (`canUndoStart`, `undoStart`): admins, while nobody has used the new cycle: no check-in in it, no goal in it changed or added by a person, and no later cycle. Undo removes it as a deleted cycle is (in Recently removed for 30 days); starting again makes a new one, and the removed one can then never come back. Delete refuses a started cycle and points to Undo.

## Worked examples

Each is run against the real rule by `src/spec/spec.test.ts`: the result is what the code gives.

| Given | The rule gives |
|---|---|
| 2026 (week 0 from 22 December 2025, 53 weeks) and 2027 (week 0 from 28 December 2026): the current cycle on Monday 21 December 2026, Sunday 3 January 2027 and Monday 4 January 2027; and with 2026 alone on Monday 11 January 2027. | `2026, 2026, 2027; 2026` |
| 2027 seen on Monday 21 December 2026. | `2027 starts on Mon 4 Jan 2027, in 2 weeks. Nothing is due until then. Your first check-ins are due Thu 7 Jan 2027.` |
| Four 2026 goals: 4 → 40 pairs ending on 33; 0 → 70% whose last number is 72%; one called done; and 4 → 40 pairs its owner stopped at the wrap-up. | `carry, finish, finish, stop` |
| A goal kept at most 12.0% that ended inside its limit, and a number goal whose plan runs to week 66 of a 53-week year. | `carry, keep` |

## Not self-explanatory

- **Not self-explanatory:** A goal nobody wrapped up follows the rule (it carries on unless it met its target): the owner can still stop it during the wrap-up. Removing the copy of a goal stopped after the start is round 3’s CY4 (recarry).

## Requirements

- `CARRY-GOALS`: An admin starts the next cycle from the day the wrap-up opens, once, after a read-back in counts that add up to every goal (carry on, finish, stop, not wrapped up yet), and can undo it until someone uses it (a check-in, or a goal changed, in it). Everyone stays in the old cycle until its last day; the next opens on its week 1's Monday, and before that every screen says when it starts and nothing is due. A goal that met its target finishes; one its owner stopped at the wrap-up stops; the rest carry on from their final number, from week 1, with their key, metric, watchers, open asks and place in reviews; no carried plan changes direction, starts late or has a stage after the year's end. Until someone uses a carried goal, a later final number or wrap-up keeps it true.
- `RESULTS`: A cycle ends on its last day (its last week's Sunday) whether or not the next is started: results and the last quarter close on the numbers there are, and nothing in it is due, late or out of date afterwards. Every place that says where the year stands gives its real first and last days: running, ending (the wrap-up's weeks), ended or not begun.
